subject: Post-call: Executive recap & procurement path for Redwood deployment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@kryptontech.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@kryptontech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: Exec summary + next steps

Hi Daniel / Maya —

Thanks again for your time today — really helpful conversation. Quick executive recap so we have a single place for action items and timeline.

Summary of pain & priority outcomes
- Current pain: slow response times from existing NLP pipeline, high per-token inference cost, and lack of a predictable capacity plan for seasonal spikes.
- Business outcomes you care about: 50% reduction in inference cost per session, sub-200ms 95th percentile latency for core search/chat flows, and clear SLA/controls for data governance.

What we discussed
- Proposed approach: Redwood Dedicated or Private deployment (depending on procurement/security needs) + caching/batching profile to meet latency and cost targets.
- Short pilot (4–6 weeks) scoped to the search/chat workload, measurable success criteria (latency, cost delta, quality thresholds).

Procurement path & timeline
- Procurement lead: Maya Singh (thanks for confirming).
- Legal/contract: Daniel, you mentioned external counsel but expect internal legal review as well.
- Target decision window: end of Q2 (you said target by June).

Open risks & ask for execs
- Data residency and auditability: you flagged this as mandatory for production. We can support VPC + KMS + audit logs; will confirm SOC 2 evidence.
- Procurement duration: if external counsel gets involved, timeline may extend — propose a parallel path: security deep-dive + pilot commercial term to shorten evaluation.

Next steps (owner / ETA)
- Marissa: Send ROI model + SLA summary (attached) — today.
- Daniel / Maya: Confirm procurement timeline and any required security artifacts — by 4/22.
- Redwood (Laura + Aditya): Prepare draft MSA and pilot commercial term — send draft by 4/19.
- Schedule: Plan an exec sponsor briefing for week of 4/26 to align CTO / Finance.

Attachments: KryptonTech-ROI-model.xlsx, Redwood-SLA-Summary.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with date options for the exec briefing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0126

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@kryptontech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@kryptontech.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Exec summary + next steps

Thanks Marissa — that writeup is helpful. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Priority outcomes: focus first on inference cost and auditability; latency target is important but secondary to cost/controls for our team.
- Security requirements: we need SOC 2 Type II evidence, audit logs retained for 12 months, and KMS support for keys. I’m looping in Aisha (security) for the deep dive.
- Procurement: Maya is leading procurement. Legal may involve outside counsel; I can fast-track internal CTO review (Rick Johnson) if I have a one-pager and proposed SOW/pilot terms.

I’ll confirm procurement milestones by Friday (4/22). Please include the Draft MSA and pilot pricing when you send the next note.

–Daniel
Daniel Park
VP, Platform Engineering | Krypton Tech
daniel.park@kryptontech.com
+1 (650) 555-2431

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Exec summary + next steps (leadership note)

Marissa / Laura —

Nice recap. A few leadership points and suggested playbook to keep this deal tight:

1) Escalation & risk mitigation
- Prioritize a security deep-dive with Aisha ASAP (SOC 2 artifacts, KMS, audit log retention). Offer a clear owner on our side (Laura) to drive evidence collection.
- On data residency: document options for VPC or on-prem packaging; flag any feature gaps early.

2) Commercial / pilot approach
- Recommend a short paid pilot (4 weeks) with clear KPIs. To expedite procurement, offer a limited-time pilot discount and a one-page SOW focused on measurable outcomes.
- We should be prepared to include a small credit/discount on first committed month if exec sponsor needs it.

3) Legal & MSA
- Laura, please work with legal to get a draft MSA ready for Daniel’s team by 4/19. Attach a redline-friendly draft as a starting point.

I’m cc’ing Marissa and Daniel so everyone sees the proposed next steps. Happy to join the exec briefing if that helps.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick update after internal alignment:

What we’ve done
- Sent ROI model and SLA summary on 4/18 (attached in the original thread).
- Laura has prepared a redline-ready draft MSA (attached).
- Proposed pilot commercial term: 4-week paid pilot, $15k, success criteria: 1) >=40% cost reduction vs current baseline on pilot traffic, 2) 95th pct latency < 250ms, 3) no P0 security gaps identified in the deep-dive.

Scheduled items
- Security deep-dive with Aisha (Redwood Security + Krypton Sec) — proposed 4/22 at 10am PT. Laura to lead.
- Exec sponsor briefing draft — propose 4/26 (30 min) for Rick + Finance; I will send calendar options today.

Open risks (owner)
- Data residency compliance (Laura) — confirm VPC/on-prem options and any feature limitations.
- Legal review duration (Maya / Daniel) — if external counsel is used, timing may extend; suggest parallel pilot to shorten time to value.
- Procurement lead alignment (Maya) — confirm PO process and required docs.

Next immediate asks
- Daniel / Maya: confirm security deep-dive attendees and procurement constraints by 4/22.
- Aisha: any pre-reads you want ahead of 4/22? We can circulate SOC2 summary and KMS architecture.

Attachments: draft-MSA-KryptonTech.docx
